title: Zero net applied momentum still costs source power
statement: Known monochromatic canonical momentum relation Q_y=(k_y/omega)P_abs supplies a proposed two-counterpropagating-wave actuator. Effective F_y=eta(k_y/omega)K_sigma*(p_plus-p_minus), with p_plus,p_minus nonnegative and zero integrated force, can make shear without net momentum. Independently controllable profiles and transfer into the desired coordinate are model assumptions; actual dispersion, antenna deposition and susceptibility are unacquired. The separate derivative of stored nonresonant wave-dressing momentum cannot be silently dropped in transients.

requires: Positive and negative absorbed-power profiles are independently programmable in a specified Gaussian deposition model; transfer efficiency, absorption, damping, diffusivity and width are inputs.
A turbulence-maintained mode U=A cos(kx-Omega t-theta) has a usable soft phase with acquired-in-model detuning, diffusion and force projection; this structure is not demonstrated for a reactor.

assumptions: Source-reported completed reduced-physics construction and original exploratory script; no demonstrated plasma controller, measured confinement gain, independently acquired scientific audit, novelty determination or practical advantage. Turbulence-sustained amplitude, soft phase, programmable deposition, effective coupling and phase diffusion are supplied model inputs. Actual antenna-to-wave-to-mode susceptibility, transient dressing momentum, nonlinear heat-flux payoff and equally informed matched-control comparison remain unearned. Script preserved without execution or repair; all existing holds remain.
costs: Both nonnegative wave powers, deposition selectivity, RF absorption, momentum transfer, transient stored dressing momentum and startup are paid.

Illustrative synthetic parameters and finite discretizations are not measured calibration, feasible antenna design or a full nonlinear gyrokinetic simulation; same actuator ordinary control remains a strong comparator.
